class.name: SQLiteStatement
class.brief_description: A prepared SQL statement of an [SQLiteDatabase].

method.name: bind_blob
method.description: Binds [param value] as a BLOB to the parameter at [param index]. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param index] is out of range.

method.name: bind_float
method.description: Binds [param value] as a REAL to the parameter at [param index].

method.name: bind_int
method.description: Binds [param value] as an INTEGER to the parameter at [param index].

method.name: bind_null
method.description: Binds NULL to the parameter at [param index].

method.name: bind_text
method.description: Binds [param value] as TEXT (UTF-8) to the parameter at [param index].

method.name: bind_value
method.description: Binds [param value] to the parameter at [param index], choosing the SQLite type from the [Variant] type as described in [SQLiteDatabase]. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for unsupported types.

method.name: bind_values
method.description: Binds all parameters at once: an [Array] binds by position and must have one value per parameter, a [Dictionary] binds named parameters by their name without the prefix.

method.name: clear_bindings
method.description: Sets all parameters to NULL. [method reset] keeps the bound values.

method.name: get_bind_parameter_count
method.description: Returns the number of parameters of the statement (the largest parameter index).

method.name: get_bind_parameter_index
method.description: Returns the index of the named parameter [param name], including its prefix (for example [code]":id"[/code]), or [code]0[/code] if there is no such parameter.

method.name: get_column_blob
method.description: Returns the value of [param column] in the current row as bytes.

method.name: get_column_count
method.description: Returns the number of columns in the result rows, [code]0[/code] for statements that return no rows.

method.name: get_column_float
method.description: Returns the value of [param column] in the current row as a [float].

method.name: get_column_int
method.description: Returns the value of [param column] in the current row as an [int].

method.name: get_column_name
method.description: Returns the name of [param column] (its alias if the query uses [code]AS[/code]).

method.name: get_column_text
method.description: Returns the value of [param column] in the current row as a [String].

method.name: get_column_type
method.description: Returns the type of the value of [param column] in the current row. SQLite stores a type per value, so the type can change from row to row.

method.name: get_column_value
method.description: Returns the value of [param column] in the current row as an [int], [float], [String], [PackedByteArray] or [code]null[/code], depending on its type.

method.name: get_row
method.description: Returns the current row as a [Dictionary] that maps column names to values, like a row of [method SQLiteDatabase.query].

method.name: get_sql
method.description: Returns the SQL text of the statement.

method.name: reset
method.description: Resets the statement so that it can run again from the start with [method step]. The bound parameter values are kept.

method.name: step
method.description: Runs the statement until the next result row. Returns [constant STEP_RESULT_ROW] when a row is available through the [code]get_column_*[/code] methods, [constant STEP_RESULT_DONE] when the statement has finished, and [constant STEP_RESULT_ERROR] on failure (see [method SQLiteDatabase.get_last_error_message]). Call [method reset] before running the statement again.
